annotations.title: Publish a listing with the code

description: Publishes a free basic profile with the 6-digit code from the confirmation e-mail: takes the website, the e-mail address the code went to and the code (valid 5 minutes). The profile then is public with that person as owner, marked «Vom Inhaber bestätigt» (confirmed by the owner), and the person gets a sign-in link to the dashboard by e-mail. Returns status, next and message_for_user: published (profile_url), code_invalid, email_mismatch, not_found (no listing waits for a code), exists or listed (profile_url with login_url or takeover_url), draft_incomplete or not_possible (check_url), rate_limited or temporarily_unavailable (retry_after_seconds), invalid_request (invalid_fields) or error.

code.description: The 6 digits from the confirmation e-mail, as a string, e.g. "482913".

email.description: The e-mail address the code went to.

language.description: Optional. The user's language: de, en, fr or it.

name.description: Optional. The person's name, for our records (not public).

website.description: The website the code was requested for.
